name: Zechariah (priest, son of Jonathan)
title: Priest in Nehemiah's dedication procession
summary: Zechariah, from the priestly line, participated with musical instruments in the procession at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time, along with the other singers and musicians.

keyEvents.title: Participates in the wall dedication
keyEvents.description: Zechariah was among the priests and musicians who took part in the thanksgiving procession when Jerusalem's wall was dedicated.
